ideas.pitch: An automated offline Python script validator and submission relay designed to eliminate manual Google Forms bottlenecking during an F1 technical treasure hunt.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Grand Prix: On-ground technical treasure hunt where teams solve coding challenges and submit answers under time pressure.
ideas.title: PitStop Code Validator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the operational friction of the event by providing instant offline feedback and structured submissions, aligning with the speed and efficiency theme of an F1-themed race.

ideas.pitch: A campus-mapping web utility that parses riddles dynamically to provide optimized pedestrian pathfinding between hidden QR codes.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Grand Prix: Decode the clue, navigate the campus, and find the QR in an on-ground treasure hunt.
ideas.title: RiddleRoute Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the unique physical layout of the venue and the flexibility of the hunt, directly increasing a team's speed and strategy metrics.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight team-tracking dashboard that logs scanned QR checkpoint timestamps and calculates split times like an F1 telemetry system.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Grand Prix: 10 points to 40 points progression through interconnected technical challenges and QR hunting.
ideas.title: Telemetry QR Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the F1 theme to race strategy, giving teams granular split-time analytics to decide whether to hunt higher-point distant QRs or secure nearby ones.

ideas.pitch: An offline Python toolkit with specialized cryptographic and logical reasoning modules tailored for rapid decoding of complex technical riddles.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Grand Prix: Pre-requisites include Basics of coding (Python), Logical Reasoning, and General Aptitude for puzzle-based challenges.
ideas.title: AeroCipher Decoder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific bottleneck of manual cipher breaking during high-stress time constraints, giving a distinct competitive edge in the technical challenges.

ideas.pitch: A rules-based tactical decision engine that helps teams allocate time and prioritize flexible QR tasks based on current points and remaining duration.
ideas.problem_statement: Tech Grand Prix: Flexible Hunt allowing teams to scan and attempt any task QR they discover along the way with varying point values.
ideas.title: Pitwall Strategy Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the high-level strategy and teamwork aspect of the F1 theme, appealing directly to judges evaluating problem-solving efficiency.
